title: 2020 roadmap on pore materials for energy and environmental applications
claim: MOF nodes can act as accessible co-catalytic sites in a photoelectrode composite when channels admit reactants to those nodes.
explanation: The review assigns adsorption and activation functions to metal nodes and uses a cobalt-containing ZIF coating as an example.
conditions: Channels must be sufficiently accessible to the relevant reactant molecules.
caveats: The specific reaction pathway in the cited cobalt-containing example should not be extrapolated to other nodes or reactants.
